item.title: Carrigaholt Post Office “Expected To Reopen In Near Future”

item.title: Clare Electric Car Sales Up 70% On Last Year
item.description: Electric car sales in Clare are up almost 70% on last year. New data from the Society of the Irish Motor Industry shows 59 electric vehicles were sold here in February. Overall Clare saw a 7% decrease in car sales last month however with 278 being sold this year compared to 299 in 2025.
